title: Appropriate Government private-beta review decision
authorityBoundary: The deterministic rule executes before retrieval and provider output.
Complete and reported-gap inputs remain specialist-review.
Retrieval and provider output cannot select a government, forum, State source pack or governing law.
privacyBoundary: No names, addresses, registration numbers, employee identities, wages, payroll, disputes, notices, orders, contracts, submissions or evidence bodies.
Only controlled route, source-readiness, classification, version, escalation statuses and evidence references may be processed.
sourceBoundary: The Social Security Code and Central Rules retain controlled-file fingerprints.
Other cross-code records are source-identity snapshots only.
No State or Union Territory source set is represented as complete.

approval.notes: Software implementation and tests do not constitute legal, privacy, RAG, security or release approval.
